news.title: University of Northern Iowa’s 150th anniversary arrives Sept. 6
news.summary_en: UNI will formally recognize the sesquicentennial milestone later this month, with a day of celebrations honoring the university’s 150-year history and its tradition of public service.

news.title: The Schmidt Brothers return home for the 2026 UNI Homecoming Bash
news.summary_en: For the Schmidt Brothers, performing at this year’s UNI Homecoming Bash isn’t just another stop on their busiest touring schedule yet — it’s a return to the campus all three brothers once called home.

news.summary_en: A legacy built by thousands, celebrated by all

news.title: UNI awarded nearly $1M to advance Foundry 4.0 Center
news.summary_en: The investment will add a 3D sand printer and an induction furnace, helping to enhance foundry operations while strengthening UNI’s ability to support applied research, hands-on, real-world student learning and partnerships with Iowa manufacturers.

news.title: True in spirit, strong in knowledge: 150 years at the University of Northern Iowa
news.summary_en: The 150-year history of the University of Northern Iowa is featured in the September/October 2026 issue of Iowa History Journal, thanks to an article submitted by Assistant Professor of History Kevin Mason. You can read an excerpt of the story here on Inside UNI!

news.title: UNI expands dementia outreach and education
news.summary_en: A new space in Bartlett Hall expands UNI’s work supporting people living with dementia, caregivers, families and the professionals who serve them.

news.title: A step ahead: UNI’s first nursing students enter final year with extensive clinical experience
news.summary_en: Students in the first-ever cohort of the University of Northern Iowa’s nursing program are entering their final year with strengthened clinical skills and a strong path to their future as registered nurses.
